name: claude-mem-go
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code: capture, compress, search, and recall automatically.
long_description: Go reimplementation of claude-mem's capture-compress-persist-search-recall loop. One static binary, SQLite by default, Postgres + pgvector at scale. This bundle packages the MCP stdio server (`claude-mem-go mcp`) for darwin and linux, amd64 and arm64.

tools.name: important_workflow
tools.description: Teaches the intended search -> timeline -> get_observations usage pattern between the other tools.

tools.name: search_observations
tools.description: Keyword (full-text) search over persisted observations; omit query to enumerate.

tools.name: semantic_search_observations
tools.description: Meaning-based search over observations via local embeddings and cosine similarity.

tools.name: observation_context
tools.description: A ready-to-inject memory context block for a query, on demand.

tools.name: recent_observations
tools.description: The most recent observations for the current project, newest first.

tools.name: session_start_context
tools.description: Renders the exact text the SessionStart hook injects automatically.

tools.name: session_observations
tools.description: Every observation recorded for one Claude Code session, oldest first.

tools.name: file_observations
tools.description: Prior observations that mention a specific file in the current project.

tools.name: get_observations
tools.description: Fetch full details for specific observation IDs.

tools.name: timeline
tools.description: Chronological context around one observation, before and after it.

tools.name: search_prompts
tools.description: Keyword search over the user's own stored prompts, when prompt storage is enabled.

tools.name: session_prompts
tools.description: Every stored user prompt from one session, oldest first.

tools.name: add_observation
tools.description: Explicitly persist a fact, decision, or preference into memory.
